nodes.name: owner

nodes.name: lock
nodes.authority: internal (callers: startSeed, poke, pokeInSwap, withdrawAll, rescue)

nodes.name: onlyRegistry
nodes.reachability: The single authority gate for custody actions. `registry` (CauldronSeeder.sol:160) is written once in the constructor and is immutable, so the gate can never rotate, be renounced, or dead-end while the registry lives. It guards `startSeed` (CauldronSeeder.sol:175), `withdrawAll` (CauldronSeeder.sol:565) and `rescue` (CauldronSeeder.sol:597); DERIVED: `fundPrime` (CauldronSeeder.sol:251) reverts with the same `OnlyRegistry` (CauldronSeeder.sol:252) error but does NOT use this modifier and does not admit the registry itself.

Runs once at deployment. `deployer` (CauldronSeeder.sol:161) is pinned to the deploying address and becomes the first of the two admins the funding gate at `owner` (CauldronSeeder.sol:252) accepts; `registry` (CauldronSeeder.sol:160) becomes the sole custody authority. DERIVED: all four slots are immutable and no setter exists, so a mis-wired registry can only be fixed by redeploying the seeder and re-pointing `setSeeder` (CauldronRegistry.sol:327).
observations: comment at `unused` (CauldronSeeder.sol:82) says `positionManager` is unused now that placement is core-level; code at `positionManager` (CauldronSeeder.sol:162) still stores it and no other line in the file reads it

nodes.reachability: Any address can push ether in with no bookkeeping: the balance is not credited to `ethTotal` (CauldronSeeder.sol:189) or to `primeBudget` (CauldronSeeder.sol:255). nodes.name: poke

nodes.name: fundPrime
nodes.authority_gate_quote: if (msg.sender != deployer && msg.sender != IRegistryOwner(registry).owner()) revert OnlyRegistry(); (CauldronSeeder.sol:252)
nodes.value: receives native — `fundPrime` is payable (line 251) and the whole amount is added to `primeBudget` (line 255)

nodes.name: primePending
nodes.reachability: Pure view over campaign state; also called internally at `primePending` (CauldronSeeder.sol:240). Returns 0 unless `primeTo` (CauldronSeeder.sol:266) is set, `primeBudget` (CauldronSeeder.sol:266) is non-zero and `seeding` (CauldronSeeder.sol:266) is true. The target is `primeBudget` scaled by `placedWad` (CauldronSeeder.sol:267), so it is a pure function of stream progress; the dust floor at `PRIME_MIN_WEI` (CauldronSeeder.sol:272) is waived on the final tranche. The result is finally clamped to the live native balance at `bal` (CauldronSeeder.sol:274), so an under-funded contract asks for less rather than reverting.

nodes.name: _primeStep

nodes.reachability: Only reachable from the dispatch at `_primeStep` (CauldronSeeder.sol:349) on the `ACT_PRIME` tag (CauldronSeeder.sol:347), which in turn is only opened at `unlock` (CauldronSeeder.sol:241). The swap is tagged with this contract at `abi` (CauldronSeeder.sol:294) so the hook can waive fees; `_isExemptPlayer` (CauldronHook.sol:2466) requires BOTH `taxExempt` (CauldronHook.sol:2467) and `isOpener` (CauldronHook.sol:2467) to be set for the seeder, which matches the note at `setOpener` (CauldronSeeder.sol:282). Ordering: the delta is settled at `settle` (CauldronSeeder.sol:298) before the accounting write at `primeSpent` (CauldronSeeder.sol:300).

nodes.name: pokeInSwap
nodes.authority: hook (the address stored in _key.hooks at summon)

nodes.name: _pendingStep
nodes.reachability: Called at `_pendingStep` (CauldronSeeder.sol:232) and `_pendingStep` (CauldronSeeder.sol:309). Returns 0 while `seeding` (CauldronSeeder.sol:317) is false or `complete` (CauldronSeeder.sol:317) is true. The target is a pure function of elapsed time via `deployedTargetWad` (SeedLib.sol:58), so the stream cannot be accelerated by poking more often; the throttle at `minStepWad` (CauldronSeeder.sol:321) is waived once the target reaches 1e18 so the last slice always lands.

nodes.name: _advance
nodes.reachability: Runs after a successful placement, from `_advance` (CauldronSeeder.sol:235) or `_advance` (CauldronSeeder.sol:312). It recomputes the schedule rather than adding the step, so `placedWad` (CauldronSeeder.sol:330) is snapped to the time-based target and the throttle remainder is never lost or double-counted; the `step` argument is explicitly discarded at `step` (CauldronSeeder.sol:334). Sets `complete` (CauldronSeeder.sol:333) once the target reaches 1e18, after which the early exit at `complete` (CauldronSeeder.sol:317) returns 0 forever for this campaign.

nodes.signature: function unlockCallback(bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes memory)

nodes.name: _placeStep
nodes.value: NONE directly — both mints are paid or collected by `_settle` (line 412)

Both bands are sized against the CURRENT tick read at `getSlot0` (CauldronSeeder.sol:368), not the launch tick, and the step amounts are taken from the non-base remainder computed at `streamTok` (CauldronSeeder.sol:370) and `streamEth` (CauldronSeeder.sol:371). A band the cap declined comes back empty and is skipped by the `aHi` (CauldronSeeder.sol:388) and `bHi` (CauldronSeeder.sol:393) guards, which exist because `getLiquidityForAmount1` (CauldronSeeder.sol:389) divides by zero when lo equals hi.

nodes.name: _teardown
nodes.value: ERC20 transfer of the brew token to `to` at `transfer` (line 435); sends native to `to` at `call` (line 437); pool proceeds are pulled in first by `_settle` (line 430)
nodes.reachability: Only from the fall-through dispatch at `_teardown` (CauldronSeeder.sol:352) on the fall-through branch, which only the `ACT_WITHDRAW` unlock (CauldronSeeder.sol:566) opens, and that is `onlyRegistry` (CauldronSeeder.sol:565). The native send is a raw `call` (CauldronSeeder.sol:437) with all remaining gas and is required to succeed.

The range is pushed at `ranges` (CauldronSeeder.sol:476) BEFORE the mint so it is recoverable even if the mint reverts the transaction, and it deliberately bypasses `_reserveRange` (CauldronSeeder.sol:474) so a full-range band never becomes a per-side fallback.

nodes.name: _reserveRange
nodes.signature: function _reserveRange(int24 lo, int24 hi, bool isAsk) private returns (int24, int24)

Past the cap it degrades to the per-side fallback in `_lastAsk` (CauldronSeeder.sol:545), or declines the placement entirely by returning an empty band at `return` (CauldronSeeder.sol:550).
observations: comment at `reverts` (CauldronSeeder.sol:111) says placement reverts once the range cap is hit; code at `MAX_RANGES` (CauldronSeeder.sol:544) instead returns a tracked same-side fallback at `return` (CauldronSeeder.sol:551), and the later note at `DEGRADE` (CauldronSeeder.sol:509) documents that reversal

nodes.name: startVest
nodes.signature: function startVest(uint256 fromGen, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 escrowed)

Preconditions are an allowance to this escrow on the dead token, checked implicitly at `transferFrom` (MigrationVesting.sol:221), and a non-zero amount at `ZeroAmount` (MigrationVesting.sol:173). The trailing `_release` (MigrationVesting.sol:177) is what makes an instant-tier migration a single transaction; for a vesting grant it moves nothing, and unlike the strict path at `NothingToClaim` (MigrationVesting.sol:251) it does not revert when nothing is due. Reentrancy is blocked by `nonReentrant` (MigrationVesting.sol:170), which matters because the payout at `transfer` (MigrationVesting.sol:286) calls an arbitrary token.
observations: comment at `escrowed` (MigrationVesting.sol:167) says the return equals `amount` 1:1; code at `delta` (MigrationVesting.sol:230) lowers it to the measured balance delta whenever the delta is smaller

nodes.name: vestBatch

NEW: a holder who already carries `MAX_BATCH_GRANTS` (MigrationVesting.sol:196) open grants is SKIPPED too - a sub-cap below the absolute `MAX_GRANTS` enforced in the push - so a permissionless caller cannot fill the array a beneficiary's only exit has to walk, and one uncooperative entry cannot kill the keeper batch. The amount taken is the lesser of balance and allowance at `amt` (MigrationVesting.sol:199), so the escrow never pulls more than the holder authorised. Guarded by `nonReentrant` (MigrationVesting.sol:191), which matters because the loop touches caller-supplied dead tokens.
observations: the dead token is re-read from the registry inside the loop at `generationToken` (MigrationVesting.sol:194) rather than once before it, so an N-holder batch pays N external calls for the same answer (DERIVED)

nodes.name: _pullAndVest
nodes.signature: function _pullAndVest(address holder, uint256 fromGen, uint256 amount) private returns (uint256 escrowed)
nodes.value: pulls the holder's dead tokens into this escrow at `transferFrom` (line 221) and receives the live token from the registry's burn-and-claim at `claimByBurn` (line 227)
nodes.reachability: The only place a grant is pushed, and therefore the only place the array's bound can be enforced: `MAX_GRANTS` (MigrationVesting.sol:217) is checked here so no present or future caller can grow a holder's array past what the single bounded loop in the release path can walk. The pull is CHECKED at `transferFrom` (MigrationVesting.sol:221), so a token that returns false instead of reverting cannot book an unfunded grant. What is escrowed is verified against the actual delivered balance - measured before and after at `before` (MigrationVesting.sol:226) and `delta` (MigrationVesting.sol:229) - and clamped DOWN to the delta at `escrowed` (MigrationVesting.sol:230), with a zero result refused at `ZeroAmount` (MigrationVesting.sol:231), so a misreporting registry or token cannot inflate a grant. The window is 0 for an instant-tier wallet and `vestWindow` (MigrationVesting.sol:233) otherwise, and the grant records the live token per-grant at `token` (MigrationVesting.sol:235) because a later relaunch changes it.

Reverts with `NothingToClaim` (MigrationVesting.sol:251) when nothing is currently vested, which is the only difference from the silent release at `_release` (MigrationVesting.sol:177). Guarded by `nonReentrant` (MigrationVesting.sol:249) because the payout at `transfer` (MigrationVesting.sol:286) hands control to an arbitrary token.

nodes.name: claimFor
nodes.authority: anyone (keeper; funds go to the named holder)
nodes.value: ERC20 transfer of each grant's pinned token to the named holder, performed by `_release` (line 257)
nodes.reachability: Permissionless keeper convenience. The recipient is the `holder` (MigrationVesting.sol:257) argument, and `_release` (MigrationVesting.sol:264) pays that same address, so a caller can never redirect someone else's vested tokens. Reverts with `NothingToClaim` (MigrationVesting.sol:258) if the holder has nothing due, so a batch keeper must filter with `claimable` (MigrationVesting.sol:321) first.

nodes.name: _release

The payout is now CHECKED at `TransferFailed` (MigrationVesting.sol:286) and the release bookkeeping is written just before it at `released` (MigrationVesting.sol:271), so a token that returns false instead of reverting rolls the whole thing back: previously the unchecked transfer booked the payout, counted it, and then the prune at `total` (MigrationVesting.sol:289) DELETED the grant, leaving the beneficiary with nothing to re-claim. Fully drained grants are pruned by swap-and-pop at `gs` (MigrationVesting.sol:292) with the index only advanced on the other branch at `i` (MigrationVesting.sol:295), so the swapped-in grant is examined in the same pass. nodes.name: _vestedOf

Otherwise it is linear from the deposit timestamp at `start` (MigrationVesting.sol:303), saturating at `window` (MigrationVesting.sol:304). The pro-rata division at `total` (MigrationVesting.sol:305) truncates, so rounding always favours the escrow over the beneficiary until the window closes, at which point the full `total` (MigrationVesting.sol:304) is returned.

nodes.name: _isInstant

An unset oracle short-circuits to false at `stakerOracle` (MigrationVesting.sol:309), so the safe default is that everybody vests. The external call at `isInstant` (MigrationVesting.sol:312) goes to an owner-controlled address and is wrapped in try/catch, so a revert is read as not-instant at `catch` (MigrationVesting.sol:313); an oracle that returns true for everyone would make every grant instant. It reports total-minus-vested at `total` (MigrationVesting.sol:332), which counts the still-unvested portion INCLUDING amounts already released — it does not subtract `released` (MigrationVesting.sol:324) the way the claimable side does, because a released amount is by definition already vested.

The owner is the OpenZeppelin Ownable owner set at `Ownable` (MigrationVesting.sol:152) and can be transferred or renounced.

nodes.reachability: Owner-only and unbounded: any address, including zero, can be installed at `stakerOracle` (MigrationVesting.sol:360). It is the one knob that decides whether a new deposit vests at all, since `_isInstant` (MigrationVesting.sol:233) gives a zero window to anyone the oracle blesses. There is no timelock or event-delay here beyond whatever the owner contract imposes, and no validation that the target implements `isInstant` (MigrationVesting.sol:312) — a non-conforming address simply reverts into the catch and everybody vests.

nodes.name: renounceOwnership

The owner is the only party who can call `setVestWindow` (MigrationVesting.sol:352) or `setStakerOracle` (MigrationVesting.sol:359), so renouncing would pin the vest window and the instant-tier oracle permanently. It strands no funds either way: the owner has no path to escrowed balances, whose only exit is the beneficiary-directed release at `_release` (MigrationVesting.sol:264) (DERIVED).

nodes.name: deployedTargetWad
nodes.signature: function deployedTargetWad(uint64 startTs, uint64 window, uint256 nowTs, uint256 seedFloorWad) internal pure returns (uint256 wad)
nodes.reachability: The whole schedule. Linked into the seeder and called at `deployedTargetWad` (CauldronSeeder.sol:318) to size the next step and again at `deployedTargetWad` (CauldronSeeder.sol:328) to snap the bookkeeping, so both use identical inputs within one transaction. The floor is clamped to 1e18 at `seedFloorWad` (SeedLib.sol:63) so an over-large floor cannot produce a target above 100%.

The top is clamped at `capTick` (SeedLib.sol:121) and degeneracy repaired at `lower` (SeedLib.sol:123).
